description: Read-only distilled context for one owned Dayze Contact: profile fields, conversation prep (hobbies, interests, topics, strengths, frictions, boundaries from conversation_context), and recent logged interactions. Pass person_id (preferred) or name. Email/phone need pii:read; notes need include_notes=true. Same not-found for missing and non-owned contacts. Never-share contacts and interactions are omitted. Changes nothing. ($0.05; API key required)

include_notes.description: Include free-text notes (default false). Contact details in notes still need pii:read.

name.description: Contact name or alias when person_id is unknown. Ambiguous matches return candidates.

person_id.description: Contact UUID from get_people / resolve_person (preferred when known).

recent_limit.description: Most recent interactions to include (default 5, at most 20).

name: get_person_context

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

items.description: { id, name } when the name is ambiguous.

conversation.description: hobbies, interests, topics, strengths, frictions, boundaries, lifestyle.

inspect_note.description: How to cite: link each record with its inspect_url, never a link built from an id; which record types here have no Dayze page.

title: Get Person Context
